title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter, unless the context clearly requires otherwise:

"Housing assistance program" means a section 8 housing choice voucher program or any permanent supportive housing program.

"Rental transaction" means any part of the process for the rental or lease of a premises for residential purposes.
bodyHtml:
[§368F-1]  Definitions.  As used in this chapter, unless the context clearly requires otherwise:

     "Housing assistance program" means a section 8 housing choice voucher program or any permanent supportive housing program.

     "Rental transaction" means any part of the process for the rental or lease of a premises for residential purposes. [L 2022, c 310, pt of §2]
